ValidationRule.description: Freight - If “IATA Agent” is selected as the Agent Type then mandatory to enter IATA#
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Freight_Account" ), ISPICKVAL(Type, "Freight-Branch"), ISPICKVAL( Freight_Agent_Type__c , "IATA Agent"), (ISBLANK( IATA_Number__c )))
